name: RPS Flag Hunt
description: Print the 7 × 6 board once and choose two teams in distinct colors. Each cylinder plate makes one 14-piece team. Each ninja plate makes one team from 14 bodies and 14 keyed heads. Test-fit a body and head before printing the ninja team. Print the board seats up, and print the pieces upright. Use PLA at 100% scale with a 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, and supports off. The 2 × 2 test board checks seat fit and underside engraving. Stand each piece with its rear role symbol facing its owner.
